Readiness probe for the service. Returns 200 `{"status":"ready"}` while the process accepts traffic AND Postgres answers a ping AND a Kafka broker answers a metadata request (reachability only: topics are never required, the service's writers auto-create them). The dependency verdict is cached for a few seconds. Returns 503 `{"status":"not_ready"}` once graceful shutdown has begun (readiness is flipped first so a Kubernetes readinessProbe stops routing new requests during the drain window), and a 503 problem+json of type `dependency-unavailable` (the detail names the failing dependencies) while Postgres or Kafka is not reachable. Separate from `/healthz`, which is liveness and is never flipped by shutdown or by a dependency.
